sentences.text: 1 (b) There is an arbitration clause in the agreement between the Government and the various Rice Mills.
(c) The contract with the Rice Mills is in the nature of a non-statutory contract and such a non-statutory contract is not subject to writ jurisdiction.

In my view, the main issue in the writ petition is whether the State Government has the power to deviate from the specification provided by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution Department that are passed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

sentences.text: The issue is whether in the Essential Commodities Act and Food Safety and Standards Act, the State Government is only an implementing authority or it has the power to provide specifications different from the one provided by the Central Government, as has been done in the present case.
It is to be noted that service has not been completed on respondent Nos. 8, 9 and 10.

In my view,
these respondents are required to appear in this matter for a fruitful adjudication of the same.

Accordingly, the Registrar, Original Side is directed to serve a copy of the writ petition as well as copy of the order passed in Court today to the respondent Nos. 8, 9 and 10 and file compliance report on the next date.
Let the matter appear on 3rd September, 2019.
